en.title: Percy Jackson Season 3 Trailer: Annabeth Captured, Titans Rise in Epic Quest
en.summary: The first full trailer for Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 is here, revealing Annabeth's abduction and Percy's perilous mission to save her. Get ready for a darker, more intense chapter as the fight against the Titans escalates.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for demigods everywhere. The first full trailer for **Percy Jackson & the Olympians** Season 3 has officially dropped, giving us a tantalizing glimpse into the epic adventure that awaits Percy, Annabeth, Grover, and Thalia. This upcoming season promises to adapt Rick Riordan's gripping third novel, **The Titan's Curse**, and the trailer wastes no time in setting the stage for a war against the formidable Titans.

We see Percy Jackson, once again portrayed by Walker Scobell, gearing up for a confrontation that will test his courage and leadership like never before. Alongside his loyal friends, including Leah Sava Jeffries as Annabeth Chase and Aryan Simhadri as Grover Underwood, Percy must protect a new generation of demigods who are unaware of their true heritage. The trailer also introduces Tamara Smart as Thalia Grace, daughter of Zeus, highlighting her crucial role as a reluctant partner to Percy in the face of overwhelming odds. The stakes are immediately raised when a pivotal confrontation leads to Annabeth's capture, sending Percy on a desperate quest to rescue her from the clutches of Kronos' forces.

## The Titan's Curse Unleashed

The narrative thrust of Season 3 centers on Annabeth's abduction by none other than Luke Castellan and the powerful Titan Atlas. This event propels Percy into a perilous journey, a quest unlike any he has undertaken before. The official synopsis teases that he must not only rescue Annabeth but also "free a goddess in chains" and confront the dreaded "Titan's curse." Adding another layer of complexity is the Great Prophecy, a foreboding prediction that the fate of Olympus rests on the shoulders of one child from the Big Three gods. The trailer hints at these monumental challenges, showcasing intense action sequences and the growing threat of the Titans, who are clearly making their move to overthrow Mount Olympus.

> "If Percy Jackson learned anything after completing two epic quests with Annabeth Chase, it’s that he would be lost without her. So when Annabeth is captured by the forces of Kronos, Percy must embark on a perilous journey to rescue her." 

It's clear that Percy's motivation goes beyond mere friendship, even as he insists otherwise, much to the amusement of Aphrodite, played with characteristic flair by Kate McKinnon. The trailer underscores the deep bond between Percy and Annabeth, suggesting that their relationship will be a central emotional anchor amidst the chaos.

## What Fans Can Expect

The release of this trailer has ignited fervent excitement within the **Percy Jackson** fandom. Fans have eagerly awaited the live-action adaptation of **The Titan's Curse**, a book many consider a pivotal moment in the series, introducing significant characters and escalating the overarching conflict. The trailer offers a strong indication that the series is committed to honoring the source material while delivering visually stunning and emotionally resonant storytelling. The focus on Annabeth's capture and Percy's subsequent rescue mission promises a narrative rich with peril, sacrifice, and the burgeoning heroism of its young protagonists. The introduction of new demigods and the looming threat of the Titans are sure to keep viewers on the edge of their seats.

## What's Next

**Percy Jackson & the Olympians** Season 3 is set to premiere on Disney+ on November 20, 2026. Fans should keep an eye out for further sneak peeks and character reveals as the release date approaches, anticipating a season that delves deeper into the mythology and the escalating war for Olympus.

By Vanessa Armstrong | Published on November 2, 2026 Credit: Disney/David Bukach Comment 0 Share New Share Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 Trailer Sees the Titans Take Annabeth&url= target=”_blank” title=”Twitter”> Percy Jackson & the Olympians Season 3 Trailer Sees the Titans Take Annabeth” target=”_blank” title=”Pinterest”> Credit: Disney/David Bukach The third season of Disney+’s Percy Jackson & the Olympians is headed our way this November, and today we got our first full trailer hinting at what’s in store for Percy and his friends in the upcoming episodes. In it, we see Percy prepping for an imminent war with the Titans and teaming up with Annabeth (Leah Sava Jeffries), Grover (Aryan Simhadri), and Thalia (Tamara Smart), daughter of Zeus. The team is set up to protect children who don’t yet know they’re half-bloods, presumably from the Titans. A related altercation leads to Annabeth getting abducted, and Percy is sent on a quest to save her… because they’re just good friends, no burgeoning hormonal feelings between the two at all, Percy swears, though Kate McKinnon, who is wonderfully cast as Aphrodite, knows better. Here’s the official synopsis for season three, which sheds more light on the situation: If Percy Jackson learned anything after completing two epic quests with Annabeth Chase, it’s that he would be lost without her. So when Annabeth is captured by the forces of Kronos, Percy must embark on a perilous journey to rescue her. He must free a goddess in chains, confront the Titan’s curse, and avoid triggering the fall of Olympus. With Grover by his side, Percy must join some unlikely questmates to confront a prophecy with dire consequences. Those who’ve read The Titan’s Curse, the third book in Rick Riordan’s series on which the show is based, know that the goddess in chains is Artemis, who will be played in the show by Dafne Keen . We’ll get to see how the story unfolds when season three of Percy Jackson & the Olympians premieres on Disney+ on November 20, 2026, with new episodes releasing weekly after that.
